'''Bunduki''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Pacanth Reach/Legends|Pacanth Reach]]. It was home to the [[Followers of Palawa]], who developed the martial art of [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]].<ref name="SotES" /> Many of the Followers, including [[Arden Lyn]], fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]<ref name="tep" /> and joined the [[Legions of Lettow]].<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|II|268|Lyn, Arden}}</ref> The planet was conquered by the [[Epicanthix]].<ref name="SotES" />

[[Dux Pike's wife|The mother]] of [[Zan Pike|Zan]] and [[Zu Pike]] was an important [[Noble/Legends|noble]] of Bunduki.<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Young [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] heir [[Yun]] was sent to Bunduki to learn patience from the Followers of Palawa, though he returned to [[Yun's father|his father]] when they refused to train him in teräs käsi. Following his seduction by [[Sariss]]&mdash;and the dark side&mdash;Yun, now a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], returned to Bunduki with an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force to revenge himself on the Followers. There, the group encountered Arden Lyn, who was likewise seeking vengeance against the [[Monk/Legends|monks]].<ref name="Dark Forces" />
